name: hof
description: Higher-Order Function combinators.  The combinators every program uses -- `dip`, `keep`, `bi`, `tri`, `both`, `times`, `each`, `map`, `filter`, `fold`, `find`, `any` and `all` -- are builtins, and need no `use`. This module has the rest: `when` and `unless`, which run a function value on a condition; `bi_star`, which runs two function values on two values; and `fold_right`.  Every one is generic, and `when` and `unless` take their function value with a stack variable, `..a`, so it may have any arity.

functions.name: bi_star
functions.signature: (x:T y:T f:fn(T -- U) g:fn(T -- U) -- a:U b:U)
functions.description: Run two function values on two values, the first on the first and the second on the second. Factor's `bi*`: `f` runs under `y`, then `g` on `y`.

functions.name: fold_right
functions.description: Fold an array right to left: `f` runs on each element and the accumulator, last element first, as `fold` runs on the accumulator and each element first to last.
examples: arr 0 fn { + } hof::fold_right  // sum of array

functions.name: unless
functions.description: Run a function value only if the condition is false, as `when` runs it when it is true.

params.name: q
params.description: Function value, run when the condition is false

functions.name: when
functions.description: Run a function value only if the condition is true. It must leave the stack the shape it found it, since when the condition is false nothing runs.

params.name: q
params.description: Function value, run when the condition is true
